rig_rules.B: One global B rig returns transform, wing articulation, feet state and resolved occluders. T07/T08 use it unchanged; only drawing ownership differs.
rig_rules.G_P_C: P-C root carries receivers, A, R, L mount/linkage and gate. After respective seating cues all mounting coordinates remain fixed. G is never re-created or independently rescaled during2250–2400.
rig_rules.fixed_W_guide: World-fixed reference, not a child of P-C. For2250–2400 measure P-C motion relative to W-guide before camera projection. Common camera may move both on screen.
rig_rules.P_hinges: P-C↔P-A and P-A↔P-B shared edges each have one identity and computed endpoint pair. Connected faces reference those endpoints rather than interpolate duplicate vertices. P-C remains flat; P-A finishes its opening before P-C slides; P-B opens after2520.
rig_rules.F: One corner set with four persistent IDs and shared edge lengths. Folded reserve must be visible before material is paid out. S7 absence clears all F pixels and its shadows/trails.
rig_rules.Q: Shelf, stop, axle and feed share one physical assembly. Stop clears at1590 before rotation1620; Q remains in T04 through3600 and never becomes the original red-stock reel.
rig_rules.S7: Apply offsets to original groups, not redrawn illustration. At full separation: back(-70,-54), middle(-54,-2), front(+18,+25), operator(-54,-2), F(+30,-7), B(+100,-37). Hold other states2940–3090.
rig_rules.S8: Miniature world transforms original T02/T03/T04/T06/T09 only; exclude B and F before scaling. Final targets F[140,181,1000,397], B[1053,143,.8,0,6], foot y181.4, frame top181.

camera_design.S1: Use exact embedded opening curves through299; do not reinterpret contacts. Foreground approach uses source frameState projection.
camera_design.S2_to_S6: R03 poses are screen-space composition targets; solve world-rig and shared camera together. Do not interpolate each screen polygon as a different world or independently reset pages at scenes. Side→top and top→side rebases only behind the stated real card/pillar occlusion.
camera_design.S4: Keep start/platform/gate in view through1260. Camera follow displacement must be smaller than B displacement during flight so the arc remains visible. One convex flight arc1320–1515; finite settle1515–1560.
camera_design.S6: P-C slide2250–2400 occurs in fixed W-guide world coordinates. Camera retreats as world opens; dynamic scale/translation must be one shared function. No camera angle/perspective/3D added.
camera_design.S7: No camera motion2940–3090; complete-world state is the baseline.
camera_design.S8: Only small continuous retreat3240–3420; camera and world fully settled by3480.
camera_design.unresolved_proof: R06 must solve interpolation against these endpoint contracts and test all frames for shared hinges/contact order. R03 static targets do not prove a rigid-motion solution; if a target conflicts, make a bounded reviewed design correction, never hide a jump.
